scope: Completed installed-package public regression qualification, composite record (see qualification_basis)
qualification_basis: The full public suite ran on artifacts built from commit e137879b76a58dacacd27b4e7256d85c776cc53e. Between that commit and the release commit only REPRODUCE.txt, the rc5 validation record's location, one README guard assertion and its partition pin changed. All 344 files inside the release wheel are byte-identical to the tested wheel; the source archive differs only in tests/test_publication_implementation.py and PUBLIC-TEST-PARTITION.json. On both platforms the single failure was test_reference_readme_preserves_platform_history, asserting the README wording before the author's 25 October 2026 edit; the corrected assertion passes against the release files.

windows.role: functional compatibility evidence, not a patched security environment

linux.role: qualification environment; distribution OpenSSL and Expat carry Ubuntu security backports (independently checked)

fixed_in_rc6: whole-phase deadlines on every network read phase

limits: Composite record: no single all-green run on the release commit; see qualification_basis.
Not a penetration test of a running deployment, nor a review of AWS KMS or CloudHSM account configuration.
Deploy only on vendor-patched Python interpreters and operating-system libraries.
